Signs and Symptoms of Alcohol Addiction
blocks.html: Signs and Symptoms of Alcohol Addiction

blocks.text: Ever wonder what an alcohol addict is like? In this article, we will talk about the signs and symptoms of alcohol addiction.
blocks.html: Ever wonder what an alcohol addict is like? In this article, we will talk about the signs and symptoms of alcohol addiction.

blocks.text: People who suffer from alcohol addiction will frequently put alcohol drinking above all of their other responsibilities. It includes family, friends, hobbies, and work. Plus, this desire towards drinking might build up a physical tolerance. You may encounter withdrawal symptoms if you suddenly stop. It can be very uncomfortable, and in some cases, life-threatening.
blocks.html: People who suffer from alcohol addiction will frequently put alcohol drinking above all of their other responsibilities. It includes family, friends, hobbies, and work. Plus, this desire towards drinking might build up a physical tolerance. You may encounter withdrawal symptoms if you suddenly stop. It can be very uncomfortable, and in some cases, life-threatening.

blocks.text: There is also something called harmful drinking. It is different from alcohol addiction. Harmful drinking is an irregular pattern of drinking, which can still cause damage to your well-being. One example of harmful drinking is boozing too much at a party and putting yourself at risk of getting in a fight or an accident. And this drinking practice may evolve into alcohol addiction, particularly if harmful drinking begins to be more regular.

blocks.text: Here are a few of the common signs and symptoms of alcohol addiction.

blocks.text: Denial that You have Drinking Problems
blocks.html: Denial that You have Drinking Problems

blocks.text: Denial is one of the most significant barriers to getting help for alcohol addiction. The urge to drink is uncontrollable once you’re addicted. Your brain finds a lot of ways to make excuses for your drinking. Denial stops you from looking honestly at your actions and its effects. Here are some of the ways that you may be denying that you have drinking problems.

blocks.text: Substance abuse specialists make a distinction between alcohol addiction and alcohol abuse. Unlike people suffering from alcohol addiction, alcohol abusers possess some capacity to set boundaries on their boozing. On the other hand, their alcohol intake is still dangerous and harmful to themselves and others, as well.

blocks.text: Continually Drinking Despite Consequences
blocks.html: Continually Drinking Despite Consequences

blocks.text: When you continue to consume alcohol even if you are experiencing complications in your relationships, then you have a drinking problem. For example, you are still grabbing a drink with friends, though you are aware that your wife or husband will become very upset. Or getting mad with your family because they don’t like your behaviour when you drink.

blocks.text: If you are frequently neglecting your duties at school, home, or work due to alcohol drinking, then there’s a problem. For example, missing classes, performing poorly at work, disregarding your children, or missing out on responsibilities because you are hungover.

blocks.text: If you are experiencing recurred legal dilemmas because of your constant drinking, then it is a serious matter. For instance, you get caught driving under the influence of alcohol or getting arrested for drunken and unruly behaviour.

blocks.text: You may also be consuming alcohol in physically dangerous situations. For example, you drink alcohol while driving, operating a machine while drunk, or mixing prescription medications with alcohol against the orders of the doctor. All these are dangerous and should be appropriately addressed.

blocks.text: You Drink to Relax
blocks.html: You Drink to Relax

blocks.text: Several drinking problems commence when people consume alcohol to relieve stress or relax. For instance, you are looking for an alcoholic drink every after an exhausting day. Or you may also be consuming at least a bottle of alcohol whenever you argue with your boss or spouse. Drinking to relax is not a good way to deal with problems. It only allows you to escape your issues momentarily. However, it will not be able to help you solve your problems.

blocks.text: Tolerance Buildup to Alcohol
blocks.html: Tolerance Buildup to Alcohol

blocks.text: When you have an alcohol addiction, it means that you are physically dependent on alcohol. If you count on alcohol to function or feel an irresistible urge to drink all the time, then you have a drinking problem. Alcohol tolerance implies that over time, your body demands more and more alcohol to achieve the same effects.
blocks.html: When you have an alcohol addiction, it means that you are physically dependent on alcohol. If you count on alcohol to function or feel an irresistible urge to drink all the time, then you have a drinking problem. Alcohol tolerance implies that over time, your body demands more and more alcohol to achieve the same effects.

blocks.text: The first significant warning sign of alcohol addiction is tolerance. Do you need to drink a lot more than you used to so that you can feel relaxed? Are you capable of consuming more alcohol than others without getting extremely drunk? These are questions that you need to ask yourself so that you can determine if you have to build up alcohol tolerance.

blocks.text: Experiencing Withdrawal Symptoms
blocks.html: Experiencing Withdrawal Symptoms

blocks.text: The second significant warning sign of alcohol addiction is withdrawal. Do you want a drink to calm yourself first thing in the morning? Consuming alcohol to avoid or minimize withdrawal symptoms is an indication of alcohol addiction. When you drink alcohol in larger volumes, your body gets accustomed to the effects of alcohol. Your body will experience the symptoms of withdrawal if you stop drinking.
